about: Arm TK1_rON_GC at production scale (class TK1, 500 individuals = 1000 chromosomes, 1 Mb, crossover r = mu x 1.5711, gene conversion at 2 r with 300 bp mean tracts): calibrated rates, the four seeds, site counts, and the mtime-free payload hashes (gz_payload_sha256: decompressed lines except '##' meta lines) of the genotype and polarization tables it writes. `synth_truths.py arm --arm TK1_rON_GC --out DIR` regenerates it (~3 s); params/seeds/counts and both payload hashes are expected equal under pins.json versions.
